heading.title: Day 1 · May 28 · Kyoto arrival
heading.sub: KIX → Arashiyama bamboo → Kiyomizudera → Gion evening stroll

infoBox.text: Land 09:20. Budget ~60 min for immigration + luggage. Should clear by ~10:20.

events.title: Land at KIX
events.desc: Clear immigration → collect bags → pick up Suica/ICOCA or confirm rail pass at JR desk in the arrivals hall.

events.title: KIX → Kyoto Station
events.desc: Haruka Limited Express non-stop · departs every ~30 min from Platform 1 · 75 min · covered by JR Pass (¥1,880+¥530 without pass)

events.title: Kyoto Station — store large luggage
events.desc: Coin lockers near Hachijō central exit (B1) · ¥700–900 for large. Or ship direct to Hotel SUI via Yamato Takkyubin (~¥1,500).

events.title: Kyoto Station → Saga-Arashiyama
events.desc: JR Sagano Line from Platform 33 · 17 min direct

events.title: Lunch at Arashiyama
events.desc: Yoshida-ya (tofu kaiseki) · Shige (soba) · Hakusui-so (matcha set). Eat before the bamboo walk.

events.title: Arashiyama
events.desc: Bamboo Grove (free) → Tenryu-ji Garden ¥500 → Togetsukyo Bridge → Kimono Forest near the station.

events.title: Arashiyama → Hotel SUI Kyoto Kiyomizu
events.desc: Bus 11 from Arashiyama Tenryu-ji-mae stop → Kiyomizumichi stop · ~45 min

events.title: Check in — Hotel SUI Kyoto Kiyomizu
events.desc: Drop bags, freshen up.

events.title: Kiyomizudera
events.desc: 5 min walk uphill from hotel. Evening light is golden. Entry ¥400. Walk down Ninenzaka & Sannenzaka stone lanes.

events.title: Gion — Hanamikoji Street
events.desc: 20 min walk via Ishibei-koji lane. Best geiko/maiko spotting window: 19:00–20:30.

events.title: Dinner — Gion Tanto or Katsukura Shijo
events.desc: Gion Tanto — Kyoto home cooking, book ahead · Katsukura — premium tonkatsu, easier walk-in

heading.title: Day 2 · May 29 · Kyoto — Uji loop
heading.sub: Walden Woods coffee → Heian Jingu → Okazaki → Uji matcha day → Fushimi Inari

events.title: Walden Woods Kyoto ☕
events.desc: 750 m walk from hotel · specialty coffee + morning pastries. Opens 08:00.

events.title: → Heian Jingu
events.desc: Walk to Gojo bus stop → Bus 100 or 206 to Heian Jingu-mae · ~20 min

events.title: Heian Jingu
events.desc: Enormous vermillion torii. Free grounds. Inner garden ¥600 optional — beautiful iris in late May.

events.title: Okazaki Shrine
events.desc: 10 min walk from Heian Jingu. Guardian rabbit statues. Free entry.

events.title: → Uji (Kintetsu Uji Line)
events.desc: Bus to Kyoto → Kintetsu Kyoto Station → Kintetsu Kyoto Line to Kintetsu-Uji · ~50 min

events.title: Fukujuen Uji
events.desc: Tea factory tour + matcha tasting + lunch. Book the factory tour slot online.

box.text: Friend recommends: "แนะนำ Fukujuen" — authentic Uji tea from source.

events.title: Byōdo-in
events.desc: UNESCO World Heritage. The ¥10 coin building. Entry ¥700. Book timed Phoenix Hall interior online.

events.title: Tsubameya
events.desc: Famous warabi mochi. Short walk from Byodo-in.

events.title: Uji Shrine
events.desc: Looking-back rabbit guardian shrine. Free entry.

box.text: Friend: "บันไดสูงมาก เตรียมใจให้ดี" — very steep stone stairs.

events.title: → Fushimi Inari (JR Nara Line)
events.desc: From JR Uji Station (5 min walk south from Kintetsu-Uji) → JR Nara Line to Inari Station · 18 min

events.title: Fushimi Inari Taisha
events.desc: Free. Walk the lower torii tunnels to the first plateau (~40 min loop). Late afternoon golden light through the orange gates. Skip the full 4-hr summit today.

events.title: → Hotel SUI
events.desc: JR to Kyoto Station (10 min) → Bus 207 to Kiyomizumichi · ~45 min total

heading.title: Day 3 · May 30 · Ine tour → Osaka
heading.sub: Pre-booked Ine no Funaya tour (all day) · Check in Hotel Shinpoin tonight

infoBox.text: Ine tour is pre-booked. Steps below = bookend transit only. Confirm pickup & drop-off with your operator.

events.title: Check out — Hotel SUI Kyoto Kiyomizu
events.desc: Full checkout — moving to Osaka. Ship bags to Hotel Shinpoin via Yamato Takkyubin (~¥1,500) or use station lockers.

events.title: Ine no Funaya day tour
events.desc: ~2.5 hr bus north to Ine fishing village · boat cruise of the bay · traditional boathouses on the sea · local seafood lunch · return bus to Osaka area.

box.text: Friend: Ine is scenic and worthwhile — particularly beautiful on a clear day.

events.title: Check in — Hotel Shinpoin Osaka
events.desc: Your Osaka base for 3 nights. Dotonbori is 10 min walk for a late snack.

heading.title: Day 4 · May 31 (Sat) · Kobe day trip
heading.sub: Kitano mansions → Kobe beef → Herb Gardens gondola → Nankinmachi → Ichiren

infoBox.text: Saturday — book Kokubu Steak reservation well in advance!

events.title: Hotel Shinpoin → Kobe Sannomiya
events.desc: Subway Midosuji to Umeda (¥230) → Hankyu Kobe Main Line to Sannomiya (¥330) · ~45 min

events.title: Kitano Ijinkan
events.desc: Meiji-era Western mansions. 15 min uphill walk from Sannomiya. Combo ticket ~¥1,000.

events.title: Kokubu Steak
events.desc: Walk ~15 min downhill from Kitano. Opens ~11:30. Teppanyaki Kobe beef. Book reservation ahead.

events.title: Kobe Nunobiki Herb Gardens
events.desc: Walk ~15 min north to Shin-Kobe ropeway. ¥2,000 return gondola. Panoramic harbor views. Lavender & roses in late May.

events.title: Nankinmachi
events.desc: 20 min walk south. Colorful street stalls. Dumplings and sesame balls are good.

box.text: Friend: "เนื้อไม่อร่อย" — skip the meat/beef stalls here.

events.title: Ichiren
events.desc: Near Sannomiya/Motomachi. Friend's top Kobe pick.

box.text: Friend: "อร่อยมาก ข้าวผัด + ราเมง" ⭐⭐

events.title: Sannomiya → Hotel Shinpoin Osaka
events.desc: Hankyu to Umeda (¥330, 27 min) → Subway to Nipponbashi (¥230) · ~55 min total

heading.title: Day 5 · Jun 1 (Sun) · Ise · Mie
heading.sub: Kintetsu express → Geku → Naiku → Okage Yokocho street food → return

infoBox.text: Sunday — Ise Jingu is packed. Arrive Naiku before 10:30. Book Kintetsu Ltd. Express seats in advance.

events.title: Hotel Shinpoin → Kintetsu Osaka Namba Station
events.desc: 8–10 min walk from hotel.

events.title: Kintetsu Osaka Namba → Ujiyamada
events.desc: Kintetsu Limited Express (Hinotori premium) · ~1h 45min direct. Book reserved seat ahead. ~¥3,200 each way incl. surcharge.

events.title: Geku — Ise Outer Shrine
events.desc: 5 min walk from Ujiyamada. Free. Dedicated to food goddess Toyouke-Omikami. Serene cedar forest.

events.title: Geku → Naiku via CAN-BUS
events.desc: CAN-BUS from Geku bus stop to Naiku (内宮) · 15 min · ¥430 round trip (recommended)

events.title: Okage Yokocho
events.desc: Eat before entering Naiku (no food inside). Must-try: Akafuku mochi · Ise udon · Tekone sushi. Walk the Oharaimachi-dori shopping street.

box.text: Akafuku is the iconic Ise souvenir. Buy fresh + one to take home (lasts 2 days). Get before noon on Sunday.

events.title: Naiku — Ise Inner Shrine
events.desc: Japan's most sacred shrine. Home of sun goddess Amaterasu. Free entry. Cross the Uji Bridge, walk ancient cedar paths, bow at the outer sanctuary. No photography past the first torii.

events.title: Ujiyamada → Kintetsu Osaka Namba
events.desc: Bus back to Ujiyamada → Kintetsu Ltd. Express return. Book return seat when booking outbound.

events.title: Evening dinner options
events.desc:
Kizu Market — Friend: "แนะนำตลาดคิซุแทน" (better than Kuromon)
Toyo — wagyu legend, join queue from ~17:30
KK Curry — Friend: "อร่อยมาก, อย่าไป rush hour"

heading.title: Day 6 · Jun 2 (Mon) · Osaka — full day
heading.sub: Kizu Market → vintage shopping → Dotonbori → Umeda Kitte → move to KIX hotel

infoBox.text: Last full day. Tonight move to Washington Hotel Kansai Airport for the 10:25 departure.

events.title: Kizu Market
events.desc: Best before 09:30. Wholesale market open to public. Fresh seafood, tamagoyaki, pickles. Standing/walking food.

box.text: Friend: "แนะนำตลาดคิซุแทน" — better than Kuromon. Cash only.

events.title: Rikuro Ojisan no Mise
events.desc: Osaka's famous jiggly cheesecake. Namba flagship bakes every 15 min. Watch through the glass, eat warm.

box.text: Friend: "อร่อย, มีขายในชานชลา shinkansen" — also airside at KIX departure if you miss it here.

events.title: Orange Street
events.desc: Minami-horie area — best vintage/second-hand fashion street in Osaka. Mix of archive, designer resale, and cheap thrift.

box.text: Friend: "Orange street ช้อปเสื้อมือสอง"

events.title: Shinsaibashi + Dotonbori
events.desc: Japan's longest covered shopping arcade → Dotonbori canal (Glico sign, Kani Doraku crab, neon riverfront).

events.title: Lunch options
events.desc:
KK Curry — Friend: "อร่อยมาก, อย่าไป rush hour" — go after 13:30
Takoyaki — Wanaka or Aizuya at Dotonbori

events.title: Namba Yasaka Jinja
events.desc: 10 min walk from Dotonbori. Giant lion-head Emaden stage — one of Osaka's most bizarre and photogenic spots. Free.

box.text: Friend: "Yasaka Jinja วัดหน้ายักษ์" — the giant-faced shrine. A must-see Osaka oddity.

events.title: Umeda — Kitte Osaka
events.desc: Subway to Umeda (¥230, 7 min). New Kitte Osaka mall near JR Osaka Station — curated Kansai regional products and food. Better than airport souvenir shops.

box.text: Friend: "ห้าง Kitte รวม OTOP kansai" — excellent curated regional goods.

events.title: Return to Hotel Shinpoin — pack & check out
events.desc: Final pack. Check out by ~19:00. Tonight moves to KIX Washington Hotel for early flight.

events.title: Hotel Shinpoin → Washington Hotel Kansai Airport
events.desc: Subway Midosuji to Namba → JR Kansai Airport Rapid to KIX (¥1,080, 65 min) → free hotel shuttle OR walk from Rinku Town station

events.title: Check in — Washington Hotel Kansai Airport
events.desc: Early night. Flight 10:25. Be at KIX check-in counter by 08:00–08:30.

events.title: Wake up & check out
events.desc: Pack remaining omiyage. Free hotel shuttle or 5–10 min covered walk to KIX terminal.

events.title: KIX — check in, immigration, security
events.desc: International departures 4F. Allow 60–75 min total. Duty-free and Rikuro Ojisan are past security airside.

events.title: Last buy: Rikuro cheesecake airside
events.desc: Friend confirmed it's sold airside on the departure concourse. Perfect last grab.

events.title: KIX → DMK (Bangkok Don Mueang)
events.desc: Boarding ~10:00. Flight ~5h 30min. Arrive DMK 14:25 local time.

tips.text: Omiyage checklist: Akafuku mochi (Ise) · Rikuro cheesecake (airside) · Yatsuhashi (Kyoto) · Kitte Osaka regional goods · Matcha from Fukujuen (Uji)
Uji: Fukujuen ⭐ · Tsubameya warabi mochi ⭐ · Uji Shrine steep stairs ⚠️ · JR bridge view > Kintetsu side
Kobe: Ichiren fried rice + ramen ⭐⭐ · Kitano good · Nankinmachi meat 👎 · Cup Noodles Museum = meh
Osaka: Namba Yasaka Jinja (giant lion) · Kizu Market > Kuromon · Toyo wagyu (long queue) · KK Curry (avoid rush hour) · Orange Street vintage · Kitte Osaka OTOP · Rikuro cheesecake
Compare rail pass cost vs paying per ride. Haruka KIX express alone = ~¥2,410 each way without pass.
